custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the keywork on the bassoon. AI often struggles with the complex mechanical linkage of woodwind keys. Check if the keys appear to float or if the rods pass through the keys logically. Also, verify the hand positions: are the thumbs and fingers positioned naturally for playing, or do they merge with the instrument? Compare the clarity of the bassoon vs. the oboe; inconsistencies in detail level may indicate generation bias.
